design_decisions.decision: Rule path decides subscribe via in-memory watchlist + ref_count with no await between; browser callbacks skip watched symbols. Rejected tracking a separate upstream-sent set.
Alert worker retries a failed batch row by row so one bad row does not drop others; rejected dropping the whole batch.
Backfill runs inside Database.connect (Python-normalized symbols); rejected a Services-level step needing a fake method.
Existing Dashboard test needed no change (its fetch mock returns [] for every URL). FakeFinnhubClient already records subscribed/unsubscribed/get_symbols; unchanged.

implementation.self_critique: Unsubscribe race (browser leaves, unsub in flight, rule created) can send unsubscribe then subscribe in order; fine. Real FinnhubClient connect-time union is covered only via get_symbols, not a real-client connect test.
